newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Mei Ah to study video-on-line business.
newsitem.headline: Mei Ah to study video-on-line business.

text.p: Movie video distributor Mei Ah International Ltd said on Tuesday it was participating in a feasibility study of the "video-on-line rental" business.

"The company has signed a memorandum of understanding with Win's Movie Investment Ltd, Chinaland International Industrial Ltd and Maximum Potential Ltd to undertake a feasibility study of 'video-on-line rental' business," it said in a statement.
But the company will depend on the outcome of the study and may or may not proceed with the business, it added.
In late January, Mei Ah proposed a one-into-five share split, a bonus issue and a bonus warrant issues.
Mei Ah also said apart from the video-on-line study and the January proposal, it was not aware of any reasons for the recent price increase of its share price.
Shares of Mei Ah closed on Monday at HK$0.615, up HK$0.07. They were down HK$0.13 at HK$0.485 in late Tuesday trade.
